(gdb) info files
0x00005555555550e0 - 0x00005555555552ad is .text
0x00005555555552b0 - 0x00005555555552bd is .fini
0x0000555555556000 - 0x0000555555556062 is .rodata
0x0000555555558000 - 0x0000555555558010 is .data
0x0000555555558010 - 0x0000555555558018 is .bss
--Type <RET> for more, q to quit, c to continue without paging--
